description: This file defines a report parser class for generating general ledger reports in an Odoo module, including methods for data retrieval, date range calculation, and account line processing.

classes.name: general_ledger
classes.description: A report parser class for generating general ledger reports, with methods for context setup, date range calculation, account hierarchy processing, and line retrieval.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the report context, including date range and account filtering based on input data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context variables and configurations.

methods.name: get_min_date
methods.description: Calculates and returns the minimum and maximum date range for the report based on fiscal year, period, or move line data.

methods.name: get_children_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves child accounts of a given account, including their balances and initial balances if requested.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Fetches all move lines for a given account, including counterpart information and currency adjustments.

methods.name: _sum_amount_account
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a specified amount (debit, credit, or balance) for an account.

methods.name: _sum_debit_account
methods.description: Calculates total debit for an account, including initial balance if specified.

methods.name: _sum_credit_account
methods.description: Calculates total credit for an account, including initial balance if specified.

methods.name: _sum_solde_account
methods.description: Calculates the balance (debit minus credit) for an account, including initial balance if specified.

methods.name: _sum_amount
methods.description: General method to sum amounts across child accounts or move lines.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Sum of debit amounts across relevant move lines.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Sum of credit amounts across relevant move lines.

methods.name: _sum_solde
methods.description: Sum of balance (debit minus credit) across relevant move lines.

methods.name: _set_get_account_currency_code
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the currency code for a given account.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency code of the current account.

methods.name: _sum_currency_amount_account
methods.description: Calculates total amount in account currency for a given account.
